dispositions.reason: Repository identity checks reject broader prior history/delta and guard reviewer export.

Changed or uncertain closures are selected automatically; independent relevance assessment, affected dispositions and batch carry-forward rationale are required. D4 is a separate count-limit regression.
Fresh proof recovers lost historical output and keeps history gaps visible, but D1 allows older proof without a fresh recovery assessment.
Nonzero-exit provider diagnostics are sanitized; malformed successful output still leaks through parser errors.
Scoped official capability references, both native manifests and subprocess contract smoke are supplied; live activation is explicitly not claimed. D3 is a new hook implementation defect.

findings.title: Missing newer evidence restores an older PASS without fresh proof
findings.regressionSetup: Obtain all required PASS results and a current packet, subsequently obtain a code FAIL for the same candidate, remove the newer result JSON or a required artifact, and check acceptance before fresh proof. It must remain blocked, then pass after fresh qualified proof bound to the gap.
findings.probe: Actual CurrentCore.check with in-memory retained results and a missing newer result returned allowed:true and code PASS. Source and proof qualification were stubbed as intact to isolate admission selection; this was not a full filesystem integration reproduction.
findings.remedy: Require a current recovery assessment/record bound to observed evidence gaps before substituting current applicability, while retaining original failure and lost-history visibility.

findings.title: Malformed provider JSON still enters visible error summaries
findings.regressionSetup: Pass a private sentinel as malformed outer or nested/fenced structured output from a successful provider process; verify both adapters and resulting gate summaries omit raw text.
findings.probe: parseClaudeStructuredOutput('PRIVATE_PROVIDER_CONTEXT_SENTINEL') returned a native JSON parse error containing a PRIVATE_PR fragment. Nonzero-exit sentinel probe was sanitized successfully.
findings.remedy: Translate provider parse failures to bounded structured errors without provider text or native parse diagnostics.

findings.title: Merge hook fails open for a missing configured feature home
findings.regressionSetup: Use an explicitly configured workspace with an absent feature home and issue recognized direct gh pr merge. Expect supported deny JSON, not an empty allowing response.
findings.probe: Exact hook body with context/access dependency substitutes returned {} for a configured context whose featureHome access raised ENOENT. This is an isolated branch probe, not a live host tool event.
findings.remedy: Deny missing/unavailable records for governed/configured features; distinguish any deliberately unguided repository exemption explicitly.

findings.title: Closed-history accumulation imposes a count-based review halt
findings.regressionSetup: Accumulate 33 resolved findings with distinct original and closure reports; change source so prior closures lack exact applicability; request review. Continued bounded assessment must remain possible without deletion or manual repetition of unaffected IDs.
findings.probe: Exact selection block with 33 already closed finding/closure pairs threw the 64-reference backlog error, despite no open findings.
findings.remedy: Use bounded batching, provenance-preserving compaction, or a supported fresh-assessment strategy while retaining original reports and stable finding identities.
